purpose: Record the bounded invariants disclosed when truth-governance controls change; this is review evidence, not a live provider or production claim.

claims: Coverage events retain bounded aggregate-only shape validation and cannot carry raw request evidence.
Coverage is withheld from current truth unless it is bound to a verified main identity and its completed observation window is still inside the declared Truth Lease.

A passed coverage claim requires a server-owned, exact-target Cloudflare witness, deployment-to-window ordering, an independently written aggregate digest, and the canonical App-aware repository credential path.
A release-observer credential is scoped to the enrolled project and cannot submit passed coverage without the matching independent witness.
Truth-sensitive changes require a substantive documentation refresh and a structured invariant receipt; whitespace-only documentation edits cannot satisfy the gate.
Repository reads that need production identity proof prefer a repository-scoped GitHub App installation credential and retain an explicit local-token fallback only for development.
The bounded current-truth event feed separately retains the newest validated main-source fact so high observation volume cannot erase the identity needed to classify coverage.
